entry.name: providerOrder
entry.label: Ordered list of provider IDs for compact and full views.

entry.name: claudeVisible
entry.label: Whether Claude is shown in the widget.

entry.name: codexVisible
entry.label: Whether Codex is shown in the widget.

entry.name: grokVisible
entry.label: Whether Grok is shown in the widget.

entry.name: kimiVisible
entry.label: Whether Kimi is shown in the widget.

entry.name: cursorVisible
entry.label: Whether Cursor is shown in the widget.

entry.name: opencodeVisible
entry.label: Whether OpenCode is shown in the widget.

entry.name: commandcodeVisible
entry.label: Whether CommandCode is shown in the widget.

entry.name: claudeWindow
entry.label: Selected Claude usage window ID for the compact line. Empty uses the primary window.

entry.name: codexWindow
entry.label: Selected Codex usage window ID for the compact line. Empty uses the primary window.

entry.name: displayMode
entry.label: Compact representation mode: icons, text, or icons+text.

entry.name: separator
entry.label: Separator glyph between compact provider entries.

entry.name: fontScale
entry.label: Compact font scale multiplier (1.0 = theme default size).

entry.name: iconLabelSpacing
entry.label: Pixel spacing between the provider icon and its label (caption).

entry.name: labelValueSpacing
entry.label: Pixel spacing between the provider label (caption) and its value/percentage.

entry.name: showCountdown
entry.label: Whether reset countdowns are shown in the full representation.

entry.name: refreshIntervalMinutes
entry.label: Global refresh interval in minutes. Enforced floor is 5 (Claude-safe TTL).

entry.name: cautionThreshold
entry.label: Utilization percent at which the caution threshold applies (must be less than critical).

entry.name: criticalThreshold
entry.label: Utilization percent at which the critical threshold applies.

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Font family override for widget text. Empty uses the Plasma system font.

entry.name: customTextColorEnabled
entry.label: Whether the global custom text color override is active.

entry.name: customTextColor
entry.label: Global custom text color. Used only when customTextColorEnabled is true.

entry.name: labelOpacity
entry.label: Provider label opacity (0.0-1.0). 1.0 reproduces V1.

entry.name: separatorOpacity
entry.label: Separator glyph opacity (0.0-1.0). 1.0 reproduces V1.

entry.name: claudeAccentColor
entry.label: Claude accent color. Empty uses the provider identity color.

entry.name: codexAccentColor
entry.label: Codex accent color. Empty uses the provider identity color.

entry.name: grokAccentColor
entry.label: Grok accent color. Empty uses the provider identity color.

entry.name: kimiAccentColor
entry.label: Kimi accent color. Empty uses the provider identity color.

entry.name: claudeCustomIcon
entry.label: Claude custom icon: freedesktop name or absolute image path. Empty uses the default icon.

entry.label: Codex custom icon: freedesktop name or absolute image path. Empty uses the default icon.

entry.label: Grok custom icon: freedesktop name or absolute image path. Empty uses the default icon.

entry.name: kimiCustomIcon

entry.name: cursorAccentColor
